tasks.title: Set Up TypeScript SDK Project
tasks.description: Initialize TypeScript development environment and build configuration for the SDK.
tasks.details: Create tsconfig, configure Bun tooling, and ensure compilation outputs to a dist folder. Include linting and basic project scripts in package.json.
tasks.testStrategy: Run `bun run build` from the ostium-ts-sdk folder and verify that JavaScript files are produced in the dist directory.

subtasks.title: Create tsconfig and build script
subtasks.description: Define compiler options, output directory, and build script inside package.json.
subtasks.acceptanceCriteria: tsconfig.json exists with target ES2020 or above and `bun run build` compiles sources to dist.

subtasks.title: Add linter and formatting tooling
subtasks.description: Configure eslint and prettier for TypeScript sources.
subtasks.acceptanceCriteria: Running lint command shows no errors on initial codebase.

tasks.title: Port Core Utilities
tasks.description: Recreate helper utilities from Python in TypeScript including numeric formatting, error mapping, and conversions.
tasks.details: Functions in `ostium_python_sdk/utils.py` handle decimal formatting, base unit conversions and error code translation. Implement TypeScript equivalents using number and BigInt types.
tasks.testStrategy: Write unit tests for each utility function to validate inputs and outputs similar to Python behaviour.

tasks.title: Implement Network Configuration and Subgraph Client
tasks.description: Complete the TypeScript classes for network configuration and GraphQL queries based on Python implementation.
tasks.details: `NetworkConfig` and `SubgraphClient` already exist in the ts source but are minimal. Match the features of `ostium_python_sdk/config.py` and `ostium_python_sdk/subgraph.py`, providing methods to fetch pairs, pair details, open trades, orders and history.
tasks.testStrategy: Mock GraphQL responses and verify that each query method returns data in expected format.

tasks.title: Add Price Service
tasks.description: Implement the price fetcher to mirror Python’s `Price` class.
tasks.details: Provide functions `getLatestPrices`, `getLatestPriceJson`, and `getPrice` as in the Python version located under `ostium_python_sdk/price.py`. Ensure request errors are properly handled.
tasks.testStrategy: Mock HTTP requests and confirm that prices are parsed correctly.

tasks.title: Port Formulae and Funding Algorithms
tasks.description: Re-implement the mathematical formulas for funding rates, rollover, and profit calculations in TypeScript.
tasks.details: Translate `ostium_python_sdk/formulae.py` and `scscript/funding.py` to TypeScript using BigNumber arithmetic. Maintain function signatures so the SDK can compute liquidation price, funding fee, etc.
tasks.testStrategy: Cross-check results against the existing Python unit tests by running them with the same inputs in TypeScript.

tasks.title: Implement Blockchain Interaction Module
tasks.description: Create a TypeScript class equivalent to `Ostium` for interacting with smart contracts via ethers.js.
tasks.details: Port methods for opening trades, updating orders, adding/removing collateral, and withdrawals from `ostium_python_sdk/ostium.py`. Load contract ABIs and manage transaction signing using the user’s private key.
tasks.testStrategy: Use a local Hardhat fork to run integration tests that simulate trading actions and verify transaction parameters.

tasks.title: Account Balance and Faucet Modules
tasks.description: Translate the `Balance` and `Faucet` helpers to TypeScript so developers can manage balances and request testnet tokens.
tasks.details: Recreate logic from `balance.py` and `faucet.py` using ethers.js. Only enable faucet requests when using a testnet configuration.
tasks.testStrategy: Mock contract calls and ensure returned balances or faucet receipts match expected values.

tasks.title: Assemble High-Level SDK
tasks.description: Combine all TypeScript modules into a cohesive SDK exposed by `OstiumSDK`.
tasks.details: Extend the current `OstiumSDK` class in `src/OstiumSDK.ts` with additional properties for blockchain operations, balances, and faucet functionality. Ensure constructor accepts network selection and RPC URL similar to the Python SDK.
tasks.testStrategy: Instantiate the SDK in a test script and perform sample read-only calls to verify module wiring.

tasks.title: Migrate Example Scripts
tasks.description: Rewrite Python example scripts under `examples/` in TypeScript and place them in the new SDK folder.
tasks.details: Examples include faucet usage, reading balances, fetching prices, and retrieving positions. Each script should import the TypeScript SDK and demonstrate similar functionality to the Python version.
tasks.testStrategy: Run the compiled examples against a local testnet to ensure they execute without runtime errors.

tasks.title: Port Test Suite
tasks.description: Create a Jest based test suite that mirrors the existing Python unit tests.
tasks.details: Replicate tests from the `tests` directory using Jest and ts-jest. Cover formula calculations and high level SDK behaviours.
tasks.testStrategy: Running `bun run test` should execute all tests successfully with mocked blockchain and network calls.

tasks.title: Update Documentation
tasks.description: Expand README files with instructions for the TypeScript SDK and note parity with the Python version.
tasks.details: Document installation, basic usage, build steps and example code snippets. Mention early-stage status as seen in `ostium-ts-sdk/README.md`.
tasks.testStrategy: Preview README rendering and check that all code blocks compile when copied.
